feature: The T tool reads Title on a video
summary: On a video the T tool now goes by Title wherever it is named: the bar, More, Edit > Tools, the note when it is folded and the title guide's card. Its tooltip reads Title / Text (T), the mock's words. A picture still says Text everywhere.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Choose Help > Tutorials > All Tutorials... and start A title that moves: the sample recording opens and the first card reads Pick the Title tool.
Rest the pointer on the ringed tool, third on the bar, and read the tooltip: Title / Text  T.
Open Edit > Tools and find the row Title with T beside it; pick it and watch the T tool light.
Open any screenshot and rest on the same tool: the tip reads Text  T.
In that screenshot open Edit > Tools: the row says Text.

evaluate: Would you go looking for Title on a video, the way you would in Final Cut, and does finding it under that name help?
Does the tooltip saying both names (Title / Text) read well, or would you rather it said just Title on a video?
Does the name changing between a picture and a video ever surprise you, for example when you switch windows?
rough: The tooltip text matches the mock (video-title-wt.html, tTitle: Title / Text (T)), and the Edit > Tools row matches the mock's menu row (Title, T).
VoiceOver reads the bar button as Title / Text on a video, the tooltip's words, rather than just Title.

Walks could not read or photograph any tooltip on a video's bar until now, because a walk keeps a video's window invisible and a tooltip takes its window's see-through-ness; the walk harness now counts and photographs it.
